title: Rebuking the Devourer and Seeing Breakthroughs in Finances
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the secret to financial breakthroughs and God's protection in your finances. Learn how giving 10% of your income to God through the tithe can rebuke the enemy's attempts to destroy your resources and bring about miraculous provision. Join Pastor Chris as he shares real-life examples of how tithing and offerings can lead to extraordinary testimonies and a deeper trust in God's promises.
